Info

Defines structural protocol IExecutionWorker for trajectory streaming workers.

class scarajectory.core.service.communication.stream.iexecution_worker.IExecutionWorker(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining execution worker lifecycle operations.

It defines:

methods:
start - Starts worker execution for given stream session.
pause - Pauses active stream transmission.
resume - Resumes paused stream transmission.
stop - Aborts and terminates active stream transmission.
is_running - Checks whether execution worker thread is actively running.
